result: The modified front-stop binding did not clear Avoid at this stationary pose. Reported sensor6 points remained around x1219..1232 mm, outside the diagnostic region8 and within original region1 warn1.
interpretation_limits: This does not establish that front-stop strategy7 was selected by the runtime controller.
Original forward strategy still references region1; the API does not identify which active region caused the reported state.
Unchanged Avoid does not prove an unsafe close obstruction or a safe-to-ignore warning.
No navigation readiness or travel/arm-clearance validation follows from this experiment.
next_required_evidence: Controller runtime selection/priority of globalStrategy id7 前停车 versus id1 前进 when stationary.
Formal meaning of avoidStatus=1 and which fields separate warning/deceleration from protective stop.
Whether avoidSensorList reports only active-region hits or aggregates other region hits.
